intelligence.human_view: The move here is from instance to system, and it is the same move Shawn has made all day: the About unfold was one page's idea at 15:35Z; the presentation law made it every page's law at 16:22Z; the player made it an experience at 17:35Z; now the universal system makes it a citizen's tool. Each step widens the same shape without changing it: one block (what / why / what's-in-it-for-them + picture underneath), one play button, one voice alignment. The citizen version is the payoff — because a system that only Naya can use to explain herself is a brochure; a system any citizen can use to explain anything is a product. "Their product, their service, themselves, or any subject" — the list is deliberately open, because the shape does not care what it carries. And the guard around it is the list: the Checklist Law governs items ON the list, and an item that falls OFF the list escapes the law entirely — no timer fires, no floor-watch flags it, no self-audit names it. Four days of silence is the cost. The correction is mechanical, not moral: every dispatched round's item stays on the list until its page is proven whole or its owner moves it to waiting-his-hand in writing.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a magic storybook that can tell ANY story — not just Naya's story, but YOUR story too! You put in your own pictures and your own words, and the book unfolds them one by one, just like Naya's does! You could show off your favourite toy, your pet, your dream — anything! Everybody gets their own magic unfolding book!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — first we learned to tell our story beautifully, one lovely picture at a time. Then we realised: why should only we tell stories this way? Anyone should be able to put in their own pictures and their own words, and have them unfold just as beautifully — their shop, their craft, their own dear self. That's a gift you can hand to everybody.
intelligence.naya_view: I unfold my story one block at a time — and then I hand you the same shape, so your story unfolds just as beautifully, in your own pictures and your own words. You tap Allow, and I learn how to operate your world from one live page — after that, you just talk to me, and talking is the interface.
